|lore=Fires blasts of ionized energy. Causes massive disruptions in weapon, engine and computer systems aboard a target. Disables starship defenses against tractor beams.
|printings={{Card versions/Ion Cannon (Premiere)}}
|versions={{Card versions/Ion Cannon (Premiere)}}
|strategy=By Brian Lee<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20020804011354/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/dark/small/ioncannon.html</ref>

A great combo to do with the "[[Ion Cannon]]" and the "[[Turbolaser Battery]]" is to fire the "[[Ion Cannon]]" (preferably at a "Correlian Corvette" filled with passengers) at a capital Starship. Then, if you hit them, fire your "[[Turbolaser Battery]]" at the ship. It's near impossible to miss the ship considering it has an armor of 0. If you do this all in one turn the Light side can't do anything about it, which really could be nice if the starship is filled with troublesome characters like [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi{{!}}Obi-Wan]], etc.
|reviews=* [[Jeff Hansen]], "Ion Cannon", Neglected Card Series, [[Corellian Engineering Corporation (fan site)|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] (2000). A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc in the bottom-right corner of the card frame, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 7 August 2016. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-D-ioncannon-PC-Errata-2016-disc-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Ion Cannon (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): Same words as the 2013 slip. This is a full card image with the printed art, lore and title. There is no title strip and no “E”; a small round bronze disc sits in the bottom-right corner of the card frame.

The 2013 slip and the same area of the disc card image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
